request.display: D4341 (SRP, two quadrants) prior authorization request

disposition: Approved. Scaling and root planing (D4341) authorized for two quadrants (lower right, lower left). Medical necessity supported by the periodontal risk assessment and Type 1 diabetes context.

note.text: PA approval confirms medical necessity and coverage eligibility at time of review — not a guarantee of payment. Final reimbursement still depends on Timothy's HUSKY B eligibility on the date of service and a clean claim. Adjudicated by Gainwell (DSS fiscal agent) via CMAP; PA intake coordinated by the BeneCare ASO; routed through Connie. The preAuthRef is carried forward onto the D4341 lines of the Interaction 5 claims-sharing EOB.
